name: Black-Gold Brief
tagline: jtxvideo's black-gold business brief: black stage, gold numbers, a translucent gold-bordered caption bar, speaker always visible.

motion.direction: jtxvideo black-gold brief. Black stage with a faint grid (0.10–0.18), dark glass cards (`mar`, 88–92 %), thin gold lines; big numbers in condensed Oswald 112–156 px gold `ter` landing exactly on the spoken beat (never early), bright gold `gold` for very few key numbers, dark gold `goldd` borders, text `iv`; letters blur 7–12 px → 0 rising 8–16 px, 0.03–0.08 s apart. Captions 46 px, weight 800, in a translucent bar with a 6 px gold left border, bottom 360 px, never fully opaque black. The speaker stays visible all the time: overlays sit upper-centre and at the sides (5–8 highlights per video: event, key data, core contrast, bottleneck, conclusion), never a full-screen takeover; cyan only for tool / model chips (≤ 15 % of a card); red `stamp` seal rare. No gold light sweeps, no particles, no neon.
